capabilities.job: deploy a Node.js app from a Git repository
deploy a second site onto an OpenClaw, Paperclip, Hermes or DeepSeek Harness server
capabilities.why: agentic stacks host only the site created during provisioning (adding another site is refused)

Installing n8n, Supabase, Nextcloud, Mautic, LibreChat, Open WebUI, Ollama, Umami, WireGuard, phpMyAdmin and Site.pro
capabilities.where: Server → Sites → Create → One-Click Apps — these are native site types with no API installer, although catalog.apps.index lists them

capabilities.job: install a one-click app on an agentic server (OpenClaw, Paperclip, Hermes, DeepSeek Harness)
capabilities.why: those servers host only the site created during provisioning

capabilities.job: connect backup storage, set up a site's backups, take a backup, restore one, download one
Turning on or syncing a server's provider backup (billed)
Restoring an archived server (billed)

Finishing a Google Drive or pCloud connection (browser sign-in)
restore a PostgreSQL site into another or a new site

capabilities.job: find out why a site is returning a 500 error
create a new xCloud-managed Vultr server through the API (servers.store), follow its provisioning, and quote what it costs
Connecting a server from your own cloud provider
capabilities.where: Servers → Create server → Bring and Manage Your Own Server

capabilities.job: Enrolling a self-managed server
capabilities.where: Servers → Create server → Bring and Manage Your Own Server

capabilities.job: Changing or cancelling a subscription
connect a customer's own cloud provider account, or adopt a server they already own, through the API
capabilities.why: provider connection and self-managed enrolment are dashboard flows. servers.store provisions a NEW xCloud-managed Vultr server and has no adopt path

capabilities.job: work out whether a server can host the site the human wants
add any second site to an OpenClaw, Paperclip, Hermes or DeepSeek Harness server
capabilities.why: those are the agentic (AI agent) stacks, and they host only the site created automatically during provisioning. Adding a site is refused for every agentic stack, in the dashboard as well as the API — this is not a permission that can be granted. The status code varies by endpoint (WordPress create answers 403, others 422), so match on the message rather than the code.

capabilities.job: clone an agentic server
capabilities.why: cloning copies sites onto another server, which the agentic stacks do not allow

capabilities.job: work with a site's staging environment
Pushing staging to production or pulling production to staging
capabilities.where: Site → Manage Staging (on the staging site)

capabilities.job: Staging hook scripts
give a human (or yourself) shell access to debug, then take it away again
connect to xCloud over MCP and call operations safely
deploy a Docker Compose or Dockerfile app from a Git repository
publish a compose service on host port 80 or 443
capabilities.why: xCloud's own nginx owns 80/443 on an Nginx server and terminates TLS; `port` below 1024 is a 422. Remap to a free high host port

capabilities.job: pull an image from a private container registry
capabilities.why: the Docker deploy never runs `docker login` and the API has no registry-credential field; build the image from source in the repository or make it public

capabilities.job: find out why a site is slow, from data, and hand off the switches that are dashboard-only
run the routine maintenance jobs on a site — cron jobs, WP_DEBUG, magic login, plugin and theme updates, vulnerability and broken-link scans
Custom nginx snippets
answer what a team is on, what it owes and what it was invoiced, and hand off payment history and plan changes
Payment history and refunds
Adding, replacing or removing a payment method
Changing, upgrading, downgrading or cancelling a plan
Downloading a printable invoice PDF
change a plan or add, replace or remove a payment method through the API
capabilities.why: those are still dashboard actions. Billing is no longer read-only, though: payments.pay settles an outstanding invoice against the card already on file

capabilities.job: buy a branded mailbox or a mail delivery (xCloud Managed Email) plan, finish DNS verification, and give the human the connection settings

capabilities.where: the domain's own DNS host or registrar, not xCloud

capabilities.job: Refunding a mailbox or mail delivery purchase
Adding or replacing the card these purchases charge
change a server's firewall rules, unblock or ban an address, or restart, start, stop or install a server service such as nginx, MySQL, Redis or PHP-FPM
block a CIDR range through fail2ban
capabilities.why: the ban call accepts single IPv4/IPv6 addresses only; a range is a deny firewall rule
